messages:
Alex Chen: FYI I'm taking over the evening shift at 17:00 UTC. Primary = Alex, Secondary = Priya. There's a 2-hour window (19:00-21:00 UTC) where dedicated capacity autoscaling will be paused for infra maintenance. Expect reduced burst capacity.
Priya Nair: noted. Is the maintenance expected to affect hosted API latency or just dedicated?
Alex Chen: Just Dedicated pools for eu-west nodes. Hosted API will route to other regions but latency might spike for eu-west pinned workloads. Customer impact likely only for customers pinned to eu-west Dedicated.
incident-bot: INCIDENT INC-4321 created (latency spike detected). Severity: P2. Affected service: dedicated-eu-west; threshold: p99 latency > 800ms. Triggered at 2024-06-05T18:12:03Z.
Mateo Ruiz: I see the alert, thanks. I'm going to run the quick triage checklist. First: confirm whether KV cache pressure is the root cause.
Alex Chen: Good call. Mateo, if KV cache is hot, fallback is to increase capacity in the other eu pool or enable soft-fallback to compatible model variant. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-latency-triage
Priya Nair: I'm secondary but I'm remote until 19:30 UTC. If you need me to take the pager after 19:30 I can.
Alex Chen: Plan: I'll try a gentle scale-up in dedicated-eu-west (add 1 GPU shard) and watch p99 for 3 minutes. If no improvement, we'll trigger model-variant fallback and notify customers via status page.
Samira Khan: heads-up, tickets open for customer A and C are already escalated to SEs. We should coordinate messaging if we flip to fallback.
Mateo Ruiz: running command to check KV cache hit/miss:  ```bash
kubectl exec -it ded-eu-west-01 -- curl localhost:9090/metrics | grep kv_cache_hit
```
Mateo Ruiz: KV cache hitratio is 0.62 -> low for steady state. Also seeing spike in new-prefix requests from a single tenant (tenant-id: t-56321).
Alex Chen: Throttle that tenant to 10qps via rate-limiter as a temporary mitigation. Command: ```python
# admin-tools throttle
adminctl throttle --tenant t-56321 --qps 10 --duration 30m
```
Priya Nair: If throttling reduces noise we can keep primary on call and let SE handle tenant comms. If not, escalate to SRE lead. Paging matrix quick check: Severity 1 -> page @oncall-sre + execs; Severity 2 -> page primary oncall + secondary; Severity 3 -> only slack thread + ticket.
Alex Chen: After throttle, p99 dropped to 420ms within 2 minutes. Good mitigation. Incident status: mitigated but not resolved. Moving to post-incident review timeline.
incident-bot: INC-4321 updated: status=mitigated, assigned=[Alex Chen], timeline=see comments.
Priya Nair: ok to handoff at 19:00? I can take over primary from 19:30 as I said. There's a 30-min overlap after maintenance ends at 21:00 UTC.
Alex Chen: Let's do a warm handoff at 19:50. I'll write quick notes: cause = sudden tenant traffic spike causing KV cache pressure; mitigation steps = throttle tenant, gentle shard add, monitor p99, consider model fallback if shard add fails; followups = contact tenant, add rate-limit rule to protect shared capacity, add alert rule for tenant-based spikes.
Samira Khan: I'll draft the customer-facing note after final state is resolved. Also adding runbook pointer to channel: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/tenant-noise-protection
Priya Nair: Reminder on escalation: if p99 > 700ms after mitigation attempt -> escalate to SRE lead @Mateo Ruiz and page @oncall-sre. If there's any data-exfil suspicion -> immediate SEC oncall page.
Alex Chen: Agreed. Also log the temporary throttle in incident timeline and make it reversible: `adminctl throttle --tenant t-56321 --remove` when cleared.
Mateo Ruiz: I'll follow up with a perf dig tomorrow to see if shard autoscale tuning is needed. For now switching to monitoring-only.
Priya Nair: thanks — I'll take the primary at 19:50 and keep an eye until midnight. Alex, leave any other notes here before swap.
Alex Chen: Leaving final note: handoff checklist done, dashboard links: https://dashboards.redwood/internal/dedicated-eu-west, runbooks as above, PD escalation list pinned in #eng-oncall. Handing off now. :white_check_mark: 
incident-bot: INC-4321 closed by Alex Chen at 2024-06-05T19:50:01Z (status=closed).
